summary: Full regression test of the FastAPI+MongoDB -> 100% local AsyncStorage architecture migration. Verified migrated seed data loads correctly (dragon 'Sif - Demo Dragon', 16 task items, 9 times, 142 schedule slots, past completions visible on calendar), tested checkbox toggle persistence + reload, activity state toggle (Active/Brumation hides feeding tasks), dragon CRUD (create/edit/weight-entry/delete with cascading weight deletion), Admin settings persistence (weight unit), Reset & load care plan (dragons/weights unaffected, times/items/slots correctly reset to 9/16/142), and the /api/translate 'online bonus' feature (verified via direct backend curl AND via frontend network-intercepted request/response). CRITICAL OFFLINE PROOF test executed: stopped backend via supervisorctl, confirmed Overview/checkbox-toggle/Tasks/custom-item-creation all continued working flawlessly with only the translate call gracefully falling back to same-text (502 error caught, no crash). Backend restarted successfully afterward. Zero console errors related to AsyncStorage/localdb/'Ukendt lokal API-rute' found in any flow tested.
action_items: None required - migration appears solid and complete. Not deeply retested: Schedules tab 'Copy to days & periods' bulk-copy, deleting a Time slot that IS in use (should be blocked), toggling 'Automatic' on Light&Heat item, Export/Import JSON via native share sheet, and PDF guide download - these were either explicitly deprioritized in the review request (already verified in prior sessions) or lower-risk/time-boxed out; recommend a quick spot-check if time permits in a future pass but not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: bootstrap.ts correctly gates one-time migration via META_MIGRATION_KEY 'bootstrap_done_v1' and has a solid fallback to buildDefaultCareplan() if migrationSeedData.json is malformed/empty - good defensive design.
router.ts cleanly mirrors the old REST API path/method shape 1:1, so api.ts requires zero call-site changes across all screens - clean migration architecture.

translate.ts's 6s AbortController timeout + try/catch fallback to same-text is correctly implemented and verified to gracefully no-op with a live 502 error during the offline test - matches spec exactly.

IMPORTANT CLARIFICATION (not a bug): the online-translation feature assumes the item name text is written in the CURRENT app UI language (source_language passed = current language setting, not auto-detected from the text). Typing English text while UI is in Danish mode will NOT translate to Danish (since backend LLM correctly treats it as already-Danish input and echoes it). This is expected/by-design behavior inherited from the old backend's translator.py, confirmed via direct backend curl tests with source_language variations - flagging only so future testers don't mistake it for a bug.
Dragon delete correctly cascades to remove associated weight_entries from AsyncStorage (verified directly via localStorage inspection post-delete) - matches spec requirement.

NOTE FOR FUTURE TEST AGENTS: each mcp_browser_automation tool invocation appears to launch a fresh browser context/session (no localStorage persistence across separate script calls) - this caused false-positive 'data not persisted' signals in early testing. Always perform create+verify+reload sequences within a SINGLE script invocation to correctly test persistence.

success_rate.backend: 100% (translate endpoint verified working correctly for da/en source_language variants)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (Overview, Dragons CRUD+weights, Tasks/Times list, Admin settings+reset-careplan, offline-proof, online-translation-bonus)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up several TEST_-prefixed dragons and task items during testing (all within isolated single-session script runs, not persisted to any shared state since each browser session is isolated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration is solid. All core flows (Overview data/checkbox/activity-toggle/calendar, Dragons CRUD+weight+cascade-delete, Tasks/Times list+badges, Admin settings-persistence+reset-careplan, offline resilience, online-bonus translation) verified working via direct browser automation AND backend curl cross-checks. Not deeply retested in this pass: Schedules tab bulk-copy feature, blocking delete of in-use Time slot, Light&Heat 'Automatic' toggle, Export/Import JSON share sheet, PDF guide download (all either lower risk or previously verified per agent_to_agent_context_note). No red-screen errors, no AsyncStorage/localdb console errors observed anywhere.
